backend/cryptoHolding.mo: Defines the CryptoHolding type with fields for id, symbol, amount, amount invested in GBP, and current value in GBP.
backend/livePortfolioSnapshot.mo: Defines the LivePortfolioSnapshot type with a timestamp and total portfolio value in GBP.
backend/main.mo: Main actor for the backend that manages per-user crypto holdings, staking rewards, portfolio history, live snapshots, and user profiles with authorization checks via AccessControl and MixinAuthorization.
backend/portfolioHistoryRecord.mo: Defines the PortfolioHistoryRecord type capturing a timestamp, total portfolio value, and total amount invested in GBP.
backend/portfolioMetrics.mo: Defines the PortfolioMetrics type with total value, gain/loss, and percentage change fields in GBP.
backend/stakingReward.mo: Defines the StakingReward type with fields for id, symbol, amount, and reward date.
backend/timeRange.mo: Defines the TimeRange variant type with options for hourly live, day, week, month, six months, year, and all time.
backend/userProfile.mo: Defines the UserProfile type containing a single name field.
feature_evidence.json: A feature evidence report JSON file with an empty features array.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: A JSON document containing short summaries of each frontend source file describing their purpose and key implementation details.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS stylesheet defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark themes including colors for background, foreground, cards, charts, and sidebar.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Vite/React app that mounts the React root and loads the main TypeScript module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component that handles authentication state, profile setup flow, and renders the appropriate view (LoginPrompt, ProfileSetupModal, or Dashboard) wrapped in ThemeProvider and Toaster.
frontend/src/components/AddHoldingDialog: Dialog form for adding a new crypto holding with an autocomplete symbol input (with keyboard navigation), amount, and GBP amount invested fields.
frontend/src/components/AddStakingReward: Dialog form for recording a new staking reward with symbol, amount, and date inputs, converting the date to nanoseconds before calling the backend mutation.
frontend/src/components/EditHoldingDialo: A dialog component for editing an existing cryptocurrency holding, allowing users to update the symbol, amount, and GBP amount invested with form validation and toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/EditStakingRewar: A dialog component for editing an existing staking reward entry, allowing users to update the symbol, amount, and reward date with form validation and toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: A simple footer component displaying a copyright notice and a link to caffeine.ai with a pulsing heart icon.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: A sticky header component providing Internet Identity login/logout, a dark/light theme toggle, and a welcome message displaying the authenticated user's profile name.
A full CRUD management component for crypto holdings that displays a table of holdings and provides dialogs for adding, editing, incrementing, deleting, and viewing individual crypto performance.
frontend/src/components/IncrementHolding: A dialog component for adding additional tokens and GBP investment to an existing holding, computing new totals and updating the holding via mutation.
frontend/src/components/IndividualCrypto: A dialog component that displays performance metrics (gain/loss, current value, total invested) and a simulated line chart for a specific cryptocurrency symbol across selectable time ranges.
frontend/src/components/LoginPrompt.tsx: Renders a landing page with a login button using Internet Identity authentication and three feature cards highlighting live prices, security, and speed.
frontend/src/components/PortfolioChart.t: Displays a Recharts LineChart of portfolio value over time, generating data points from holdings' stored GBP values across configurable time ranges.
frontend/src/components/PortfolioComposi: Renders a Recharts PieChart showing portfolio allocation by asset, calculating values from live prices applied to holdings and staking rewards.
frontend/src/components/PortfolioOvervie: Shows a summary dashboard of total portfolio value, cost, and gain/loss, plus per-asset cards sorted by current GBP value derived from holdings data.
frontend/src/components/PortfolioPerform: Renders a Recharts AreaChart of portfolio performance over a selected time range, using holdings' stored currentValueGBP to generate evenly spaced data points.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Displays a one-time profile creation form that collects the user's name and saves it via the saveCallerUserProfile mutation before entering the app.
frontend/src/components/StakingRewardsMa: React component that displays a table of staking rewards with add, edit, and delete functionality, using dialogs and toast notifications for user feedback.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using React Query, supporting both anonymous and authenticated (Internet Identity) access, and invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useCryptoPrices.ts: Custom hook that fetches live cryptocurrency prices in GBP from CoinGecko and Revolut X APIs, with symbol-to-ID mappings for a wide range of cryptocurrencies and response validation logic.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and provider using DFINITY's AuthClient, exposing login/logout functions, identity state, and login status to child components.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend data operations including user profiles, crypto holdings, staking rewards, and portfolio metrics, wrapping actor calls with caching and mutation invalidation.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet using Tailwind CSS that defines light and dark mode CSS custom properties for the design system, plus custom keyframe animations for fade-in and pulse-glow effects.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider into the DOM root.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Dashboard page component that renders the portfolio overview and holdings manager sections with a styled heading.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom OKLCH-based colors, border radii, box shadows, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state metadata tracking a single pending feature request to revert the entire application (frontend and backend) from Version 39 back to Version 38.
